"When a handful of companies control the economy, a handful of CEOs dictate what you watch on TV, which doctor you’re allowed to see, what you eat, whether predators get online access to your kids, and what apartment you can rent," Warren said.
She added, "That’s exactly why we need to block mega-mergers."
